name: plan-and-build
title: Plan a change, then build it with tests
description: Writes a phased plan and waits for your yes, then builds one phase at a time, test first.
say: Plan the retry-logic change, then build it with tests.

inputs.name: change
inputs.prompt: What do you want to change or build?

steps.title: Write a phased plan
steps.prompt: Use /gt:gt-plan to write a phased plan, with a goal and a done condition for each phase, for: {{inputs.change}}

steps.title: Say yes to the plan
steps.message: Read the plan. Say done only if it is right: nothing is built before you do.

steps.title: Build it one phase at a time, test first
steps.prompt: Use /gt:gt-implement to carry out the approved plan for {{inputs.change}}, one phase at a time, writing the failing test first, and stop on any failure.
